caveats: Unified API to provision GPU instances across providers. Marketplace availability/rates vary by cloud, region, GPU, commitment. No single stable 4/8 or GPU additive price verified. Quote authenticated live catalog before estimating.
Null values mean unknown, not free/unlimited. No model-token cost, tax or unverified ancillary charge included.
Native browser/device/task/credit prices with unknown CPU/RAM are deliberately non-priceable. Check regime before interpreting any partial resource estimate.
H100 regime is a dated snapshot of the public marketplace (like Vast); other GPU types are not snapshotted. Billing granularity and minimums depend on the underlying cloud (unverified).

Shadeform is a marketplace/aggregator reselling third-party GPU clouds (Hyperstack, Massed Compute, Scaleway, Lambda, ...); its modes are flagged "sales" (marketplace) and priced only when the user opts in.

audit_2026_09_29.source: checked against the provider's live pricing and docs pages

snapshot_auto.quote: Once the instance has entered the 'deleting' status, the account will no longer be billed for the instance.
snapshot_auto.note: Instance status enum is creating / pending_provider / pending / active / error / deleting / deleted: no stopped/sleeping state and no snapshot mechanism in the API.

snapshot_on_demand.note: The full public API (instances create/info/update/delete/restart, clusters, sshkeys, volumes, templates) has no snapshot/image endpoint. Templates are saved launch configurations (image/docker/startup script), not disk or memory snapshots. Underlying clouds may offer snapshots in their own consoles, not through Shadeform.

harness_api.note: GPU marketplace provisioning API only; no agent harness, exec or agent integration documented anywhere in the docs/API.

egress_allowlist.quote: While Shadeform does not currently provide any firewall rules through the platform

egress_http_rules.quote: While Shadeform does not currently provide any firewall rules through the platform

ingress_rules.quote: While Shadeform does not currently provide any firewall rules through the platform
ingress_rules.note: Instances get a public IP; docker launch config uses --network=host with optional port_mappings (host_port -> container_port), which is port remapping, not access control. Underlying-cloud firewalls, if any, are not exposed through Shadeform.

guest_firewall.quote: we can set up a firewall on the GPU instance using Uncomplicated Firewall
guest_firewall.note: Official guide uses sudo ufw on the VM. Does not contain a root agent.

secret_proxy.quote: List of environment variable name and values to automatically add to the instance
secret_proxy.note: Only env vars in the launch configuration (plus registry username/password for docker pulls); no secret store or credential-injecting proxy.

volume_attach.quote: Volumes provide persistent block storage that can be attached to instances for storing data independently of the instance lifecycle.
volume_attach.note: One volume per instance, only at instance creation (volume_ids array of size one), same cloud provider and region only.
